jobs.description: Join Albert Heijn Online in Roosendaal as a delivery driver! Earn €18.83 per hour, enjoy flexible shifts and work independently on the road. Wat bieden wij? A gross all-in hourly wage of €18.83 for employees aged 21 and over, including holiday allowance and applicable additional allowances. Flexible working opportunities between 12 and 32 hours per week. The option to receive your salary weekly or every four weeks. Travel expense reimbursement for commuting. 25 days of paid annual leave based on full-time employment. Participation in a pension scheme. Employee discounts through the Albert Heijn Bonus Card. Practical training with an experienced delivery driver. Opportunities for personal development and career progression within Consolid and Albert Heijn. An independent position with responsibility and the prospect of long-term employment. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online – Roosendaal Do you enjoy driving, meeting different people and having a job that keeps you active? As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Roosendaal, you will be responsible for bringing grocery orders directly to customers. Your working day starts at the delivery location, where you prepare your vehicle for the journey ahead. You check the grocery orders, make sure everything is complete and load the crates safely into your delivery van. Once your vehicle is ready, you follow your assigned delivery route through Roosendaal and the surrounding area. At each destination, you unload the correct order and deliver the groceries to the customer's home or workplace. You provide friendly service, answer simple questions and make sure the delivery is completed correctly. Your responsibilities also include processing payments when required, collecting empty crates and returnable packaging, and recording delivery information in the delivery app. After completing your route, you return to the location, handle the returned materials and leave the delivery van clean and readyfor its next journey. You will spend much of your working day independently, while remaining part of a supportive delivery team. What are the working hours for this position? You can work between 12 and 32 hours per week. Morning shifts generally run from 06:00 to 14:00, while afternoon and evening shifts run from 15:00 to 23:00. Deliveries take place from Monday through Sunday. Your schedule will depend on your availability and operational requirements. Important: You must be available to work at least two Saturdays per month. This is a mandatory requirement for the position. Do I need previous delivery experience? No previous experience as a delivery driver is required. During your first working days, you will receive practical guidance from an experienced colleague. You will learn how to prepare your van, use the delivery app, handle grocery orders and provide excellent customer service. Is the job physically demanding? The role involves both driving and physical activity. You will regularly lift and carry grocery crates from your delivery van to customers' doors. You should therefore be comfortable performing physical tasks throughout your shift and be able to handle grocery crates safely. How much will I earn and when will I be paid? Employees aged 21 and over receive a gross all-in hourly wage of €18.83, including holiday allowance and applicable additional allowances.
